seo.title: What is answer engine optimisation?
seo.description: Answer engine optimisation is the work of getting a company cited in the answers that AI assistants write, rather than only ranked in a list of blue links.

definition: Answer engine optimisation is the work of getting a company cited in the answers that AI assistants write, rather than only ranked in a list of blue links.
answerBlock: Answer engine optimisation is the work of getting a company cited in the answers that AI assistants write, rather than only ranked in a list of blue links. Assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews summarise sources and name a few of them. Being one of the named sources is a different job from ranking tenth on a results page.

body.heading: How is it different from ordinary SEO?
paragraphs: The mechanics overlap: the page still has to be crawlable, fast and clearly about one thing. What changes is the shape of the content. An assistant extracts a passage that answers the question directly, so a page that opens with two or three plain sentences of answer is far easier to quote than one that opens with a marketing paragraph.

Specificity wins. Prices, timelines, what is included, what is not, who it is not for: these are the passages that get lifted, because they answer the question the person actually asked. Vague superlatives are unquotable.
Structured data helps a machine agree with the page about what it is looking at, and a crawlable llms.txt file gives an assistant a map of the site written for that purpose.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: A buyer who asks an assistant "who builds B2B ecommerce sites in Sacramento" and reads three names has already shortlisted before visiting a website. Being absent from that answer costs the enquiry before any sales process starts.

The work is measurable in the same way as ordinary search: which prompts name you, which pages are cited, and how many enquiries say they arrived that way, which is why the referral question on our forms includes AI assistants.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: A service page that opens with a two-sentence answer, states a starting price band and lists what is included is quotable as it stands. The same page written as a brochure paragraph gives an assistant nothing to lift.

service.title: AI search visibility
service.line: Technical SEO plus the newer work of being cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI overviews.

terms.definition: A canonical tag tells search engines which address is the official one for a page that can be reached at several addresses.
Core Web Vitals are three measurements Google publishes to describe how a page feels to the people using it: loading, responsiveness and visual stability.
llms.txt is a plain text file at the root of a website that describes the site and points to its most useful pages for AI assistants.
Structured data is machine-readable markup added to a page that states what it is about in a vocabulary search engines understand.
